name: FIA F1 Sporting Regulations 2026 (simplified for the sim)
comment: Parameters of the rule mechanics, not regulation text. Checked against '2026 F1 Regulations - Section B [Sporting] - Iss 09' (2026-10-01), ISC Appendix H 2026 (published 2026-06-23), '2026 F1 Regulations - Section A [General Provisions] - Iss 03' (2026-06-25, for points and penalty points), the 2026 F1 Penalty Guidelines v01 (FIA: no regulatory value) and the Race Director's Competition Notes Sao Paulo GP 2026 V2; Section B and Appendix H were the newest 2026 issues listed by the FIA on 2026-11-08. verified = the cited article exists in that issue and describes this mechanic; values from the Penalty Guidelines are marked verified false because they are guidance, not regulation; 'note' says where a value is a sim simplification.

yellow_speed_factor.source: ISC Appendix H 2026, Art. 2.5.5 b (single waved yellow); Section B B1.8.4
yellow_speed_factor.note: Mechanic verified: reduce speed, no overtaking, be prepared to change direction. The rule gives no number; 0.95 is a sim factor.

double_yellow_speed_factor.source: ISC Appendix H 2026, Art. 2.5.5 b (double waved yellow); Section B B1.8.4
double_yellow_speed_factor.note: Mechanic verified: significantly reduce speed, no overtaking, be prepared to stop. The rule gives no number; 0.80 is a sim factor.

vsc_speed_fraction.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.12 Virtual Safety Car (B5.12.2 b)
vsc_speed_fraction.note: The rule sets a minimum time per marshalling sector via the FIA ECU; the sim simplifies this to one share of the reference speed.

safety_car_speed_fraction.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.13 Safety Car
safety_car_speed_fraction.note: Safety Car pace is a sim value; the rule defines the procedure, not a speed.

safety_car_catch_up_fraction.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.13.2 b
safety_car_catch_up_fraction.note: Rule: queue up behind the Safety Car and stay above the minimum time per marshalling sector; the catch-up pace is a sim value. Lapped cars overtaking on the Safety Car's green light: see lapped_cars_may_overtake (M8.2).

red_flag_speed_fraction.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.14 Suspension Procedure(s)
red_flag_speed_fraction.note: Rule: proceed slowly into the Pit Lane, overtaking forbidden. The sim stops the cars before the Control Line instead of in the Pit Lane.

red_flag_free_tyre_change.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.14.4 a vii (work allowed during a suspension); B5.1.5 (tyre blankets)
red_flag_free_tyre_change.note: Whether a tyre fitted under the red flag counts towards B6.3.6 is not stated; the sim counts it (every specification used in the race counts).

pit_lane_speed_kmh.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B1.6.3 a

unserved_drive_through_seconds.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B1.9.6 c iii and d
unserved_drive_through_seconds.note: Also applies when imposed after the end of the race.

unserved_stop_and_go_seconds.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B1.9.6 c iii and d

stop_and_go_seconds.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B1.9.6 c i (period of the time penalty)
stop_and_go_seconds.note: The period is set by the stewards' decision; 10 s is the usual value and the one used in the sim.

overtake_detection_gap_seconds.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B7.2.1 b vii and B7.2.3 c
overtake_detection_gap_seconds.note: The mechanic is verified (enabled after the leader first crosses the Detection Line and after a Safety Car period; activated at the Activation Line if less than the Detection Gap behind at the Detection Line). The gap value is announced by the FIA per event and is not in the regulations; 1.0 s is a sim assumption. Used from package 6.8.

blue_flag_marshal_sectors.source: ISC Appendix H 2026, Art. 2.5.5 e; Race Director's Competition Notes Sao Paulo GP 2026 V2, section 2
blue_flag_marshal_sectors.note: The rules say 'at the earliest/first available opportunity' and give no number of sectors; blue lights come on at 1.2 s gap (team pre-warning at 3.0 s). Three marshal sectors is the sim's stand-in for 'first opportunity'.

min_dry_compounds.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B6.3.6 (with B6.1.2 b ii)
min_dry_compounds.note: At least two dry specifications in the race, one of them a mandatory race specification; void if intermediate or wet tyres were used. The sim has no mandatory specification: any two of soft, medium, hard.

two_compound_not_restarted_seconds.note: Breaking B6.3.6 means disqualification; only if the race is suspended and cannot be restarted are 30 s added instead.

time_penalty_served_at_next_stop.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B1.9.6 b i-iii
time_penalty_served_at_next_stop.note: 5 s/10 s are served at the next pit stop before any work (entries behind the SC or for a red flag do not count); otherwise added to the race time.

pit_speeding_drive_through_from_kmh.source: 2026 F1 Penalty Guidelines v01 (B1.6.3 a iii)
pit_speeding_drive_through_from_kmh.note: Guideline tariff in the race: under 6 km/h over the limit 5 s, 6-15 km/h drive-through, more than 15 km/h stop-and-go. The regulation itself only lists the possible penalties.

pit_speeding_stop_and_go_above_kmh.source: 2026 F1 Penalty Guidelines v01 (B1.6.3 a iii)

unsafe_release_penalty_seconds.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B1.6.2 a; 2026 F1 Penalty Guidelines v01
unsafe_release_penalty_seconds.note: B1.6.2 a forbids an unsafe release but sets no penalty; the guidelines allow 5 s, 10 s or drive-through. The sim expects 5 s, 10 s if it causes contact. Releasing an unsafe car (B1.6.2 b, stop-and-go) is not modelled.

track_limits_black_white_at.source: 2026 F1 Penalty Guidelines v01 (B1.8.6, ISC App. L Ch. IV 2 c); App. H 2.5.4.1 f
track_limits_black_white_at.note: Leaving the track is defined in B1.8.6 (verified). The strike count is guidance only: every offence deletes the lap, the 3rd brings the black-and-white flag.

lapped_cars_may_overtake.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.13.4 c
lapped_cars_may_overtake.note: The Race Director may let the lapped cars pass the cars on the lead lap and the Safety Car; they then rejoin the back of the queue without overtaking. The rule fixes which cars count (lapped when crossing the Control Line at the end of the lap in which they crossed the first Safety Car line for the second time after deployment); the sim takes the cars in the queue that are a lap or more behind the leader or between the leader and the Safety Car when the message is sent. For the 'appropriate speed' they drive at race pace until they reach the back of the queue. Closing the pit exit meanwhile is not modelled.

safety_car_in_laps_after_lapped_cars.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.13.5 b
safety_car_in_laps_after_lapped_cars.note: After the message the Safety Car returns at the end of the following lap, unless the Race Director keeps it out. The rule does not wait until every lapped car has rejoined the queue.

pit_entry_closed_penalty.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B1.6.4 b
pit_entry_closed_penalty.note: The Race Director may close the pit entry for safety reasons; only cars needing essential and evident repairs may enter. In the race any other entry is a stop-and-go. The sim has no repairs, so every entry while closed is an offence.

wet_tyres_void_compound_rule.note: The two-dry-specifications duty applies only to drivers who used no intermediate or wet-weather tyres in the race.

wet_start_tyre_change_penalty.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B6.3.7 (with B5.10.1 a, B5.15.2 a)
wet_start_tyre_change_penalty.note: When the Race Director mandates wet-weather tyres for formation laps or a resumption behind the Safety Car, they are compulsory until the Safety Car has gone in; changing to another specification meanwhile is a stop-and-go.

safety_car_start_laps_deducted_offset.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.10.7 and B2.5.2 a
safety_car_start_laps_deducted_offset.note: If the formation lap(s) start behind the Safety Car, the race is shortened by the laps behind the Safety Car minus this offset (one).

safety_car_start_standing_restart.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.10.8 (standing start) and B5.10.9 (rolling start)
safety_car_start_standing_restart.note: After formation laps behind the Safety Car the Race Director chooses: standing start from the grid when conditions allow, otherwise a rolling start. Not modelled yet: the sim always uses the rolling start (Safety Car in this lap, racing from the line); a standing start would need the cars back on the grid.

track_declared_wet_in_race.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B6.3.5 and the qualifying lap-time rules (B3)
track_declared_wet_in_race.note: Declaring the track wet only matters in free practice (tyre use) and qualifying (lap-time rules); Section B has no wet declaration for the race. The sim therefore has no such race command.

rain_lights_with_wet_tyres.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B1.5.5 a
rain_lights_with_wet_tyres.note: Rear lights must be on whenever intermediate or wet-weather tyres are used. Display only in the sim.

rain_hazard_precipitation_probability.note: A Rain Hazard may be declared when the official forecast gives more than 40 % probability of precipitation during the race (or at the Race Director's discretion). Used for the forecast display; the sim does not model what a Rain Hazard changes.

race_points.source: 2026 F1 Regulations Section A, A2.2.1 d (column 4)
race_points.note: Points for places 1 to 10 when the leader has completed 75 % or more of the scheduled distance; the same points count for the Drivers' and the Constructors' Championship (both cars of a team). There is no point for the fastest lap. Ties in the championship are decided by the number of first places, then second places and so on (A2.1, World Championship titles, c).

race_points_from_50_percent.source: 2026 F1 Regulations Section A, A2.2.1 c (column 3)
race_points_from_50_percent.note: Leader has completed 50 % but less than 75 % of the scheduled distance.

race_points_from_25_percent.source: 2026 F1 Regulations Section A, A2.2.1 b (column 2)
race_points_from_25_percent.note: Leader has completed 25 % but less than 50 % of the scheduled distance.

race_points_from_two_laps.source: 2026 F1 Regulations Section A, A2.2.1 a (column 1)
race_points_from_two_laps.note: Leader has completed two laps but less than 25 % of the scheduled distance.

race_points_min_green_laps.note: No points unless the leader has completed at least two complete, consecutive laps without Safety Car or Virtual Safety Car.

classified_min_distance_fraction.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B2.5.5 b
classified_min_distance_fraction.note: Cars with less than 90 % of the winner's laps (rounded down) are not classified.

race_distance_km.note: The race has the least number of complete laps that exceeds this distance. Not modelled: the two-hour limit and the three-hour limit including suspensions (B2.5.3).

race_distance_short_km.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B2.5.2 b
race_distance_short_km.note: Exception for one named street circuit; the season calendar marks the race that uses it.

start_lights.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.7.1 a and b
start_lights.note: Standing start: five red lights come on one after the other, the start signal is all lights going out. Before that the grid panels flash blue for five seconds.

start_light_interval_seconds.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.7.1 b i
start_light_interval_seconds.note: One second between the red lights. The time from the fifth light to lights out is at the starter's discretion (B5.7.1 b ii); the sim draws it from the seed.

false_start_penalty_seconds.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.11; 2026 F1 Penalty Guidelines v01 (jump start / incorrect starting location)
false_start_penalty_seconds.note: B5.11: cars must be stationary in their grid position from the third red light until the start signal, with the front tyres inside the lines. The stewards choose between 5 s, 10 s, drive-through and stop-and-go; the guidelines name 5 s or 10 s and no penalty points. Sim: 5 s is the correct penalty for a small breach.

false_start_serious_penalty_seconds.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.11; 2026 F1 Penalty Guidelines v01 (jump start / incorrect starting location)
false_start_serious_penalty_seconds.note: Sim: 10 s is the correct penalty when the car moved more than 0.2 s before the signal (a clear advantage). A car outside its grid box: 5 s.

start_repeat_laps_deducted.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.8 (aborted start) and B5.9 (extra formation lap)
start_repeat_laps_deducted.note: Each aborted start and each extra formation lap shortens the race by one lap. A driver who caused it starts from the pit lane, otherwise stop-and-go.

standing_restart_after_red.source: F1 SR 2026 Section B, B5.15.4 (standing start resumption)
standing_restart_after_red.note: After a suspension the Race Director chooses a standing start from the grid or a rolling start behind the Safety Car.

penalty_points_suspension_at.source: 2026 F1 Regulations Section A, A3.3.1 b
penalty_points_suspension_at.note: A driver who reaches 12 penalty points on the Super Licence is suspended for the next Competition; afterwards 12 points are removed. No points with a reprimand or a fine.

penalty_points_valid_months.source: 2026 F1 Regulations Section A, A3.3.1 b
penalty_points_valid_months.note: Penalty points expire 12 months after they were imposed. Sim: a season is shorter than that, so points stay for the whole season.

penalty_points_collision.source: 2026 F1 Penalty Guidelines v01 (causing a collision)
penalty_points_collision.note: Guideline for a race: 0 up to 3 depending on severity. Sim value for a penalised collision. Forcing another driver off the track: 0 in the normal case.

penalty_points_yellow_flag.source: 2026 F1 Penalty Guidelines v01 (failing to slow for yellow flags, B1.8.4)
penalty_points_yellow_flag.note: Guideline maximum for single and double yellow flags in a race.

penalty_points_overtaking_neutralised.source: 2026 F1 Penalty Guidelines v01 (overtaking behind the SC, B5.13.2 c; under VSC, B5.12.2 c)
penalty_points_overtaking_neutralised.note: Overtaking one car behind the Safety Car or under the VSC without giving the place back. Speeding in the pit lane, unsafe release, track limits, two-compound rule, closed pit entry and the wet tyre mandate carry no penalty points.

penalty_points_red_flag.source: 2026 F1 Penalty Guidelines v01 (failing to slow for red flags, ISC Appendix H 2.5.4.1 b)
penalty_points_red_flag.note: Guideline maximum. Sim: goes with a penalty for overtaking under the red flag. Overtaking before the line after the Safety Car counts like overtaking behind it.
